Nitisinone Products 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-554248  
Guideline Name 
Nitisinone Products  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Arizona (AZM, AZMREF, AZMDDD)  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
4/1/2026  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Nityr, Brand Orfadin, Generic nitisinone  
Diagnosis 
Hereditary Tyrosinemia type 1 (HT-1)  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Diagnosis of hereditary tyrosinemia type 1 (HT-1)  


--- PDF page 1246 ---
Page 1246 
 
AND 
 
2 - Diagnosis confirmed by the presence of succinylacetone in the plasma or urine  
 
AND 
 
3 - Used in combination with dietary restriction of tyrosine and phenylalanine  
 
AND 
 
4 - Prescribed by or in consultation with one of the following:  
• 
Gastroenterologist  
• 
Hepatologist  
• 
Other specialist with experience in treating inborn errors of metabolism  
 
AND 
 
5 - Applies to Nityr only; trial and intolerance to Orfadin (nitisinone) capsules or suspension  
 
Product Name:Nityr, Brand Orfadin, Generic nitisinone  
Diagnosis 
Hereditary Tyrosinemia type 1 (HT-1)  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Reauthorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Patient demonstrates a positive clinical response to therapy  
 
AND 


--- PDF page 1247 ---
Page 1247 
 
2 - Applies to Nityr only; trial and intolerance to Orfadin (nitisinone) capsules or suspension  
 
Product Name:Harliku  
Diagnosis 
Alkaptonuria (AKU)  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Diagnosis of alkaptonuria (AKU)  
 
AND 
 
2 - Used for the reduction of urine homogentisic acid (HGA)  
 
AND 
 
3 - Disease is confirmed by one of the following:  
• 
Presence of a mutation in the homogentisate 1,2-dioxygenase (HGD) gene  
• 
Presence of elevated homogentisic acid (HGA) levels in urine greater than 0.4 g/24h  
 
AND 
 
4 - Trial (of a minimum 30-day supply) or intolerance to generic nitisinone 2mg capsules  
 
AND 
 
5 - Prescribed by or in consultation with one of the following:  
• 
Rheumatologist  
• 
Geneticist  


--- PDF page 1248 ---
Page 1248 
• 
Specialist experienced in the treatment of inborn errors of metabolism  
 
Product Name:Harliku  
Diagnosis 
Alkaptonuria (AKU)  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Reauthorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Patient demonstrates positive clinical response to therapy (e.g., reduced levels of urinary 
HGA)  
 
AND 
 
2 - Trial (of a minimum 30-day supply) or intolerance to generic nitisinone 2mg capsules  
 
2 .  Revision History  
 
Date  
Notes  
3/24/2026  
New program: combines criteria for Nityr, Orfadin, Harliku.
